name: 06610 · Bridgeport, CT
findings: ZIP 06610 (Bridgeport) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06610 (Bridgeport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
